zara.docs: Quick note 1: I found three inconsistent SDK snippets: Python streaming ignores is_final, TS retry example uses old backoff, Go pagination uses 'since' cursor. I'll open a tiny PR to normalize them to the new runtime semantics and link them from quickstarts.

tom.devex: Thanks. Which files?

zara.docs: _includes/snippets/python/streaming.py, _includes/snippets/ts/retry.ts, _includes/snippets/go/pagination.go and docs/quickstarts/* replaced with codeinclude.

kevin.engineer: For Go please show context cancellation and resp.NextPageToken loop, not offset. e.g. 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
for {
  resp, err := client.List(ctx, req)
  if err != nil { break }
  // process
  if resp.NextPageToken == "" { break }
  req.PageToken = resp.NextPageToken
}
```

maya.sdk: TS should prefer built-in retry policy but show retry.withExponentialBackoff() as an example and note idempotency. Also update to check header 'x-retry-after-ms'.

zara.docs: Python streaming will use delta/is_final handling and show how to drain buffer only on is_final. I'll add migration note: "Snippets updated: next_page_token, x-retry-after-ms, streaming event handling (May 2026)".

ci-bot: Reminder: run snippet smoke tests locally; CI runs them on PR.

tom.devex: Ping me when PR is ready, I'll help review and update onboarding quickstarts if needed.
